Commands over the configuration file

Usage: dolos config [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  check          validates the configuration and prints the network and stores it resolves to,
                 without opening any of them
  write-genesis  writes a known network's genesis files, without opening any store
  help           Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  
  -h, --help             Print help
